race.description: Iron Horse Equine Nutrition Immunigen Hcp (46+)
race.comment: PARIAH'S THANKS (7) resumes with a sound profile for this grade, having won a trial at Belmont Park and with last campaign form that included a Class 3 sixth at Belmont Park beaten just over two lengths. Her final run at Pinjarra Scarpside was plain enough, but she was slow to begin and still made some late ground, so she looks well placed to make a stronger fresh return. WHAT HAVE YOU DONE (10) is race fit and building properly, backing up a Collie third with a York second when beaten just over a length, and the first-time blinkers give her a clear chance to sharpen. CASINO ROYALE (1) brings the most convincing winning form after taking out a BM56+ at Leinster by just under two lengths, with Power To Rule behind him, though he has to transfer that form to this venue. WINTER BLOOM (11) resumes after a Belmont Mdn eighth and an Open run at Belmont Park, and with only four starts behind her she has more scope than most of the lower-weight runners.
